contents.text:
Generate a production-ready kotlin Android App with single activity. Name it MainApp. 
Produce a **fully cleaned, compile-ready code** that I can paste into Android Studio following these rules:
- Use latest version JetPack Compose for the UI. 
- Use UiState, UiEvents and UiEffects for user interaction
- Use Compose Material3 for the style
- Use clean architecture + ViewModels
- Create a common Modifier for buttons and another one for Text. Use them in all buttons and text components.
- Add three composable screens: Login , Home and Catalog
- Login screen: This is the first one to be shown if the user is NOT logged in. Is a classical login screen.
- Home screen: This is the first one to be shown if the user IS logged in. It should have one Text component and 2 buttons that do nothing.
- Catalog screen: Should have a single Text component
- Use Navigation Compose and a NavHost/NavController with paths to each screen
- Add a toolbar with 3 Material3 icons that navigate to each screen when clicked. 
- Add a permissions dialog with permissions for fine and coarse location.
- no placeholders
- no duplicated helpers
- no explanatory text
